'''Phylo Daan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] working for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Phylo Daan appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Balmorra. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
